desc: 薄荷绿撞色版式下的男士圆领套头短袖，含领口与原料实证屏
leaf: 男士圆领套头短袖上衣
name: 薄荷撞色圆领套头短袖款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒给出配色与版式主张，让列表点进来的第一眼就读清圆领套头短袖的廓形与撞色标条体系
shots.textZone: 右侧竖排主标题区，卡顶标条内留一行短标位

shots.intent: 用三格等身竖卡把同一件套头短袖放进三种日常场合，制造代入感并锁住同一光位与同一裁切
shots.textZone: 三卡下方各一枚标条短标签位，顶部留一行场合总标

shots.intent: 把圆领罗纹与车线放大成一屏可读的做工证据，用一张大卡加两张小卡的标条结构承接领口卖点
shots.textZone: 每张大卡底部标条内一行主标与一行空副标位

shots.intent: 让一颗开壳天然纤维原料与成衣织面同框，把料的来源叙事变成可见证据，不写任何成分与产地数字
shots.textZone: 盘侧细线引出一枚空白标签位，顶部留一行总标

shots.intent: 以薄荷版面上对角错位的细线描边卡讲清肩线、袖口与下摆走向，承担详情页的机制解释段
shots.textZone: 版面右上主标题区带荧光衬块，其下一行空副标与两行空注

shots.intent: 把成衣放回街景光影里做垂坠与真实尺度的参照，为收口前的一段定住整篇调性
shots.textZone: 顶部一枚空标头胶囊位，左三分之一留一行短标位

shots.intent: 用非对称四格拼贴回顾全篇轮廓，并留一枚空白行动位收口，不写任何优惠数字与时效
shots.textZone: 底带内一行收口标与一行短注，行动位保持空白无数字

style.backgroundSystem: one flat page per screen assembled from set devices instead of scenery: rounded viewport cards closed by a solid leaf-green caption bar #58BE63 on a matte paper field #F5F7F4 for the cover and collar screens, a mint editorial panel #E3F1E4 carrying hairline-framed photo cards set on the diagonal for the craft screen, a letterless header tab over a deliberately blurred cool facade band for the scene band, and an asymmetric four-card mosaic on the paper field #F5F7F4 for the close; no two neighbouring screens share the same base field, no gradient, no scenic depth beyond that one blurred facade band
style.direction: fresh leaf-green menswear editorial commerce built on rounded caption-bar cards and hairline-framed photo panels
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline line marks in leaf green #58BE63, plus one letterless seal ring and one blank rectangular action slot cut into the footer band; no filled badges, no 3D icons, no numbered circles, no QR code
style.lightingSystem: cool daylight studio light around 6000K, large front-left softbox key with a right fill card, one sweeping skim of light along rib valleys, seams and husk fibres to open the surface, soft contact shadows only under hems and dish rims, no flat wash-out and no hard shadow wall, low specular
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh leaf-green menswear editorial visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte paper field #F5F7F4, mint editorial panel #E3F1E4, leaf-green caption bar #58BE63 and pine-ink text #222B20; cool daylight studio light around 6000K with a large front-left softbox key, a right fill card, one sweeping skim of light across rib and seam texture and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif as the single type family with copy only inside clean reserved zones and one headline per screen; rounded viewport cards closed by a solid leaf-green caption bar, hairline-framed photo cards and a letterless header tab as the only recurring set devices; worn screens always framed from the neck down so no face is needed; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented fabric percentages, gram weights, origin or grade claims, size figures or test data.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no fifth hue outside the four locked tones
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or handwritten lettering
no random backgrounds and no scenic depth beyond the one blurred facade band
no visible model face, no watermark, no QR code and no store or membership badge
no invented fabric composition, gram weight, origin, grade, size or test figures
style.presentationRules: worn screens are always framed from the neck down or cropped at the crown so no face is readable; the chest-height garment scale repeats across the cover and mosaic screens; on-body scale and still-life scale never mix inside one card; caption bars never cross the collar line or the hem line; the ribbed collar stays the single recurring read across screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper field #F5F7F4 as the page ground, matte mint panel #E3F1E4 as the insert ground, one shallow mint dish for the still-life screen; hairline rules and card corners are the only surface decoration, no plaster wall, no bedding, no cement floor, no laminate board
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, Chinese copy only as short placeholder lines inside reserved zones, one headline per screen, no serif, no script, no handwritten or retro lettering, no large English display lines and no dates or season codes
